entities.summary: Dampa Tiger Reserve or Dampha Tiger Reserve is a tiger reserve in western Mizoram, India. It covers an area of about 500 km2 (190 sq mi) in the Lushai Hills at an elevation of 800–1,100 m (2,600–3,600 ft). It is the largest wildlife sanctuary in Mizoram. It was declared a tiger reserve in 1994 and is part of Project Tiger.
